subject: Regional silo certification & data deletion playbook
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@finsecure.com>

Cc: security-ops@finsecure.com
Date: 2029-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: regional silo certification & deletion playbook

Hi Chloe / Laura,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our security review for the Dedicated deployment, we need formal confirmation that FinSecure's tenant is pinned to a single US region (we prefer us-west-2) and that Redwood can provide an auditable deletion/playback proof for snapshots, backups, and any cross-region replication. Specifically: 

- Can you confirm the tenant will be physically isolated on hosts within the requested region (no cross-region replication enabled by default)?
- What is the exact retention timeline applied to primary data, snapshots, and backups?
- Please attach a draft deletion/runbook we can review that includes evidence artifacts we can request (log samples, scrub reports).

We're on a tight timeline for our board review next week; a slimmed-down playbook and a region/replication assertion will be enough to move forward.

Thanks,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Infrastructure Risk, FinSecure
oliver@finsecure.com

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front and next steps below.

1) Region pinning/isolation: We can confirm we will pin your Dedicated capacity to us-west-2 and that customer compute and tenant storage for the pinned cluster are provisioned on that region's hosts only. Default product behavior does not replicate to other regions unless replication is explicitly enabled by the customer or by an agreed DR arrangement.

2) Retention summary (default config for Dedicated): primary data TTL = 90 days; snapshots retained for 30 days by default; periodic backup copies (for recovery & maintenance) are kept for 180 days unless a shorter retention is requested. We can provide customer-scoped retention overrides in the Dedicated contract.

3) Deletion / evidence playbook: attached 'silo-map-v2.pdf' that shows host/zone boundaries and mapping. Ben will follow up with the operational playbook (deletion-playbook-draft.docx) that contains step-by-step artifact generation (audit logs, snapshot manifests, wipe receipts).

Next steps:
- Ben: please attach the draft playbook and a short checklist of what evidence artifacts we can produce within 48 hours.
- Laura: I'll loop you to approve any SLA exceptions for snapshot retention if FinSecure needs shorter/longer windows.

I'll schedule a 30-min sync if helpful — propose Thu 8/15 11:00 PT.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

On Wed, Aug 14, 2029 at 10:05 AM chloe_martin@redwood.ai wrote:
> 2) Retention summary (default config for Dedicated): primary data TTL = 90 days; snapshots retained for 30 days by default; periodic backup copies (for recovery & maintenance) are kept for 180 days unless a shorter retention is requested.

Hi all — attaching the working draft 'deletion-playbook-draft.docx'. Key technical notes from ops:

- Physical isolation: tenant VMs/containers scheduling and attached block storage for the pinned cluster remain in-region. No automatic cross-region replication is configured at provisioning.
- Snapshot lifecycle: snapshots are incremental; deletion is a two-phase operation (mark -> compact -> tombstone). Compact/tombstone runs are scheduled; we can trigger ad-hoc compaction to accelerate final physical removal for compliance requests.
- Offsite backups: by default we do not copy Dedicated tenant snapshots to a different region. If a customer requests cross-region DR copies, that is an opt-in configuration which we document in the contract and control plane.
- Evidence artifacts produced on deletion: snapshot manifest (hashed), audit event stream extract (time-window), scrub job stdout + job-id, and an ops-signed deletion receipt. We include sample manifest and scrub logs in the attached draft.

Operational caveats / forensic hold: If FinSecure places a legal hold, we will suspend compaction for the affected objects until clearance. Escalation path: open a support case with Escalation: Secure-Delete. Estimated turnaround to produce evidence artifacts for a standard deletion request (no legal hold) = 48-72 hours.

Ben Carter
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: deletion-playbook-draft.docx (work-in-progress, includes sample logs)

From: Data Protection Officer <dpo@finsecure.com>

Subject: Re: Request: regional silo certification & data deletion playbook

Thanks for the quick responses and the attachments. A couple of follow-ups before we can sign off:

- Can you explicitly state whether cold storage snapshots (archival backups) are ever moved to a separate region or to third-party archival services? We need an explicit 'no' unless we sign an addendum.
- What are the immutable identifiers you provide for a deletion event (we need a hash + ops-signed receipt that ties snapshot IDs to scrub runs)?
- For the compaction window: if you compact within 30 days by default, can you provide a runnable SLA clause that guarantees final physical removal within X days after request when no legal hold exists? We prefer something measurable (e.g., final physical removal within 21 calendar days after deletion request).

Please reply with the precise wording we can include in the FinSecure contract appendix.

Best regards,
DPO
FinSecure

Hi — consolidating our responses into contract-ready wording below, happy to iterate: 

1) Region and archival movement
"Redwood Inference confirms that, for FinSecure's Dedicated tenant provisioned in AWS us-west-2, primary compute, attached block storage, and scheduled snapshots will remain in us-west-2 unless and until FinSecure authorizes cross-region replication or archiving via a written addendum. Redwood does not, by default, copy Dedicated snapshot data to other geographic regions or to external third-party archival services."

2) Immutable deletion evidence
"On completion of a deletion request (absent a legal hold), Redwood will provide: (a) snapshot manifest that includes snapshot ID, object hashes, and timestamps; (b) audit event extract covering the deletion window; (c) scrub job output including job-id and exit status; and (d) a Redwood-signed deletion receipt that binds the snapshot ID and manifest hash to the scrub job id and timestamp."

3) Physical removal SLA (proposed)
"Redwood will complete final physical removal (compaction/tombstone and associated storage reclamation) of deleted customer snapshot objects within 21 calendar days of receipt of a validated deletion request, provided no legal hold or regulatory inquiry has been placed on the data. If a legal hold is placed, the clock is paused until release."

Operational notes: turnaround to assemble the evidence pack = 48-72 hours for standard requests. We will include the sample manifests and scrub logs in the shared drive (https://redwood.mycompany.com/drive/finsecure-evidence) for your review and can push an addendum into DocuSign once you're happy with language.

If that wording looks good I'll prepare the DocuSign appendix and route to your legal.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Product Security, Redwood Inference
